9: ﻿Frontend Simplified - Virtual Internship (v2)
10: In this internship, you will be working on creating one of the most stacked websites that will prove you’re a capable developer.
11: 
12: 
13: Solution website: https://summarist.vercel.app/
14: 
15: 
16: 1. Choosing the technology
17: You can choose whatever technology you want for this virtual internship. 
18: However, Frontend Simplified used the following technologies to complete this virtual internship:
19: * NextJS
20: * Typescript
21: * Firebase (firestore + authentication)
22: * Stripe using firebase extension
23: * Redux with redux toolkit
24: * React icons
25: * Vercel
26: 
27: 
28: Feel free to use whatever technologies you feel comfortable with.
29: 
30: 
31: 2. Start
32: After you choose the technology, we will provide you with the home page design and app assets to facilitate stuff since it doesn’t really have any UI logic and we don’t want to waste your time by coding pure HTML, CSS, and grabbing assets.
33: 
34: 
35: Here is the repo for the HTML and CSS code for the home page. You will need to implement it according to your own framework of choice.
36: 
37: 
38: Link for home page and assets: https://github.com/hannamitri/summarist-home-page 
39: 
40: 
41: Img tags are left empty for you to add based on the framework you chose. Icons are left there in case you want to use react-icons.
42: 
43: 
44: In order to install react icons, use the following command: npm install react-icons
45: 
46: 
47: 
48: 
49: 3. Overall Features
50: 1. Home page (https://summarist.vercel.app)
51:    1. Design
52:    2. Authentication modal
53: * Register
54: * Login using email and password
55: * Logout
56: * Guest login
57: * Forgot password (Optional)
58: * Google login (Optional)
59: 
60: 
61: 2. For you page (https://summarist.vercel.app/for-you)
62:    1. Selected Book
63:    2. Recommended Books
64:    3. Suggested Books
65:    4. Book pill
66: 
67: 
68: 3. Inside book page (https://summarist.vercel.app/book/:id)
69:    1. Display the content of the book
70:    2. Save books in library (Optional)
71: 
72: 
73: 4. Player book page (https://summarist.vercel.app/player/:id)
74:    1. Display book title and book summary
75:    2. Build an audio player
76: 
77: 
78: 5. Sales page (https://summarist.vercel.app/choose-plan)
79:    1. Design
80:    2. Create Payments
81: 
82: 
83: 6. Settings page (https://summarist.vercel.app/settings)
84:    1. Display subscription status
85:    2. Display user email
86: 
87: 
88: 7. Search bar
89:    1. Implement a search bar
90: 
91: 
92: 8. Sidebar
93:    1. Implement a sidebar
94: 
95: 
96: 9. Skeleton loading state
97:    1. Implement skeleton loading state
98: 
99: 
100: 10. Library page (Optional)
101:    1. Display the saved books
102:    2. Display the finished books
103: 
104: 
105: 4. Features explanation & hints
106: In order to facilitate the project for you, we will be providing you some hints that will help you build the website easier. We will go in depth with each feature and how it works.
107: 
108: 
109: 1. Home page (https://summarist.vercel.app) 
110:    1. Design:
111:       1. The HTML and CSS for the home page were already provided to you at the beginning of this document.
112:       2. Optional: create the active heading on home page
113:           
114: 
115: 
116: Refer to the finished product to see its behavior.
117: 
118: 
119:    2. Authentication:
120: In this project, you’re required to use a modal for authentication.
121:       3. Register: User should be able to sign up with email and password
122:   
123: 
124:       4. Login: User should be able to login with email and password
125:       5. Logout: User should be able to logout.
126:       6. Guest login: User should be able to use a guest login
127:   
128: 
129:       7. Forgot password: Create a function that will reset a user’s password if he forgot it. (OPTIONAL)
130:       8.  Google login: add a google login feature (OPTIONAL)
131: 
132: 
133: Behavior: 
134: * If the user tried to either login or register with invalid email and password, then an error should appear. 
135: The error can be: 
136: * Invalid email (on register and login)
137: * Short password (on register)
138: * User not found (on login)
139: 
140: 
141: * If the user successfully entered everything correctly, they will be redirected to 
142: https://summarist.vercel.app/for-you
143: 
144: 
145: * If the user has successfully logged out, display the logged out state in all the necessary pages.
146: 
147: 
148: * This is mainly used for recruiters and it is easy to implement. You just need to create a dummy email and password.
149: For example:
150: * Email: guest@gmail.com
151: * Password: guest123
152: 
153: 
154: Then, you can use the login function and hardcode the email and password you created.
155: 
156: 
157: Hints: The auth modal will be used throughout the whole application, so make sure you use a global state variable to show/hide the modal.
158: 
159: 
160: 2. For you page (https://summarist.vercel.app/for-you)
161: Book object:
162:   
163: 
164:         
165: * id: unique string
166: * author: name of the book’s author
167: * title: title of the book
168: * subTitle: sub title of the book
169: * imageLink: image string of the book (can be directly added inside img tag)
170: * audioLink: audio string of the book (can be directly added inside the audio tag)
171: * totalRating: total rating of the book
172: * averageRating: average rating of the book
173: * keyIdeas: key ideas of the book
174: * type: type of the book (audio, text, or audio & text)
175: * status: status of the book. (can be either selected, recommended, or suggested)
176: * subscriptionRequired: states if user should be subscribed or not to read/listen to the book
177: * summary: summary of the book
178: * tags: tags of the book. (it is an array of strings, so it can contain multiple tags)
179: * bookDescription: description of the book
180: * authorDescription: description of the author
181: 
182: 
183:    3. Selected Book (Ignore book duration for now, but come back and do it once you finish the feature: 4.b.)
184: * Display book (from an api)
185: 
186: 
187: Api Link:
188: https://us-central1-summaristt.cloudfunctions.net/getBooks?status=selected
189: * Returns a single book object
190:   
191: 
192: 
193: 
194:    4. Recommended Books (Ignore book duration for now, but come back and do it once you finish the feature: 4.b.)
195: * Display books (from the api)
196: 
197: 
198: Api Link:
199: https://us-central1-summaristt.cloudfunctions.net/getBooks?status=recommended
200: * Returns an array of book objects
201:   
202: 
203: 
204: 
205: 
206: 
207:    5. Suggested books (Ignore book duration for now, but come back and do it once you finish the feature: 4.b.)
208: * Display books (from the api)
209: Api Link:
210: https://us-central1-summaristt.cloudfunctions.net/getBooks?status=suggested
211: * Returns an array of book objects
212: 
213: 
214:    6. Book pill
215: * You can notice the pill on the top right of the book, this should be displayed according to the “subscriptionRequired” property inside the book object. If the subscriptionRequired is false, you don’t need to display anything. If it’s true, you need to display premium.  
216: 
217: 
218: Behavior: When a user clicks on any of the books, they will be redirected to /book/:id (id being the id of the book)
219: Example: https://summarist.vercel.app/book/:id
220: 
221: 
222:    3. Inside book page (https://summarist.vercel.app/book/:id) (Ignore book duration for now, but come back and do it once you finish the feature: 4.b.)
223:    1. Display the content of the book.  
224: You need to use this api to retrieve the book by id: 
225: https://us-central1-summaristt.cloudfunctions.net/getBook?id=${id}
226: ${id} = dynamic id of the book 
227: 
228: 
229: Behavior: User clicks on the read or listen buttons.
230:       1. If the user is not logged in, the auth modal should appear (for them to register or login)
231:       2. If the user is logged in:
232:       1. If it’s a premium book and they’re not subscribed, then we need to send them to https://summarist.vercel.app/choose-plan. This will allow them to buy a subscription (Will be implemented later).
233:       2. If it’s a free book or if the user is subscribed, then we need to send them to https://summarist.vercel.app/player/:id (Will be implemented later)
234: id being the unique id of the book.
235:       3. User clicks on add title to My Library:
236:       1. If not logged in, open auth modal
237:       2. If logged in, save book details
238: 
239: 
240: Hints: Use dynamic routes in order to display the selected book.
241: 
242: 
243:       4. Player book page (https://summarist.vercel.app/player/:id)
244:       1. Display the book title and summary
245:   
246: 
247: 
248: 
249:       2. Build an audio player  
250: Behavior: A user can play/stop/skip the audio using the buttons in the middle. A user can drag the audio to a specific time. The total duration of the book should be displayed on the right. In this case it’s 4 minutes and 52 seconds.
251: 
252: 
253: Hints:
254:          * Use “white-space: pre-line;” to add some space between the paragraphs of the book summary.
255: 
256: 
257:          * To build out the audio player, you can follow this link: 
258: https://blog.logrocket.com/building-audio-player-react/ 
259: 
260: 
261:          5. Sales page (https://summarist.vercel.app/choose-plan)
262:          1. Design
263:          1. Code the design for the sales page. It should include everything there (Switching between plans, accordion, etc).
264: 
265: 
266:          2. Create Payments
267:          1. Create 2 different subscriptions. One of them should be billed monthly and the other should be billed annually (You can choose whatever prices you want).
268:          2. Yearly subscription should have a 7-day free trial
269: 
270: 
271: Hints: 
272:          * In order to set up payments, you can follow this link:
273: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xi3F2Zv91UE
274: 
275: 
276:          6. Settings page (https://summarist.vercel.app/settings)
277: If the user is not logged in, an image with a button to login should be displayed. 
278:   
279: 
280: Otherwise:
281:          1. Display subscription status.
282:          1. If the user is not subscribed, display the plan as basic with a button to upgrade that will send you to the sales page. https://summarist.vercel.app/choose-plan
283:   
284: 
285:          2. If the user bought the premium subscription, then display premium.
286:   
287: 
288:          3. If the user bought the premium-plus subscription, then display premium-plus
289:   
290: 
291: 
292: 
293:          2. Display user email
294:          1. Display the user’s email
295:   
296: 
297: 
298: 
299:          7. Search bar
300:   
301: 
302: This component should show on all pages except the home and sales page.
303: (https://summarist.vercel.app and https://summarist.vercel.app/choose-plan)
304:          3. Implementation
305:          1. You need to implement the search with a debounce (try entering some text and check how it works)
306: 
307: 
308: You need to use this api to search for books:
309: https://us-central1-summaristt.cloudfunctions.net/getBooksByAuthorOrTitle?search=${search}
310: ${search} = search input of the user 
311: 
312: 
313: The user can search a book by either the title or author.
314: 
315: 
316: Behavior: Debounce help with decreasing the number of api calls. Frontend Simplified did it in a way where it waits 300 milliseconds after the user finishes typing. So if the user typed: “How to win friends”, the component will wait 300ms before hitting the api and retrieving the results.
317: 
318: 
319:          8. Sidebar 
320: This component should show on all pages except the home and sales page. (https://summarist.vercel.app and https://summarist.vercel.app/choose-plan)
321:          4. There are 7 items on the sidebar
322:          1. For you: sends the user to /for-you
323:          2. Library: sends the user to /library
324:          3. Highlights: It’s just a not-allowed cursor and doesn’t send the user to any page
325:          4. Search: same as Highlights
326:          5. Settings: sends the user to /settings
327:          6. Help & Support: same as Highlights and Search
328:          7. Login/Logout: Either opens the auth modal or logs out the user
329: 
330: 
331: Behavior: Check the website to see the behavior. (Check out /player page to see the sidebar’s behavior on mobile)
332:         
333:          9. Skeleton loading state 
334: Skeleton loading states should show on everything that needs time to be retrieved. Some examples: For you page components, inside books page, settings page… (Check the website to make sure if you need a skeleton loading state for a specific feature)
335:          1. Implement skeleton loading state
336: 
337: 
338:          10. Library Page (https://summarist.vercel.app/library) OPTIONAL
339:          1. Display the saved books
340:          1. If a user clicked on “Add title to My Library”, it would be displayed here.
341:          2. Display the finished books
342:          1. If a user finishes a book, it will be displayed here. (A book is considered finish if the user listens till the end)
